messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — customer (Nimbus Health) asked for the full compliance evidence bundle for the POC. They want SOC 2 report, ISO cert, signed pen-test letter, and staging creds. Can we get an ETA on a single zip we can hand over? Also they asked if providing staging creds or a VPN will affect SLA/pricing.

sam_security: We can assemble the bundle. SOC2 Type II PDF + ISO27001 cert are ready. Pen-test letter needs a signed attestation from our pentest vendor — that usually takes a business-day for signature once legal signs off.

maria_sales: Cool. Customer is pushing for delivery by EOD Thursday (3 business days). Is that realistic?

sam_security: EOD Thu is tight but doable if we fast-track legal. I can put the artifact list together today. The pen-test letter: we can provide a draft signed by us first and follow with vendor signature. That usually keeps the customer moving.

josh_se: For staging creds — we prefer ephemeral read-only keys scoped to the POC project. We can create a scoped token via our staging service: `POST /v1/staging-keys {"scope":"nimbus-poc","ttl":86400}`. No SLA impact if keys are read-only and rate-limited.

maria_sales: Will the customer need a VPC peering/VPN for network access? They asked about dedicated VPC for security review.

alex_engineering: We can provision a temporary dedicated VPC for the POC but that triggers Dedicated onboarding checklist (IP whitelisting, account owner sign-off). That adds ~2-4 business days typically. If customer can use a public staging endpoint + IP allowlist, that's faster.

sam_security: Note: providing VPN/VPC access requires customer CISO signoff + network ACL review. Also need to record the access in the audit log for SOC2 evidence. No direct pricing change, but Dedicated network setups usually move to Dedicated pricing if sustained beyond POC.

maria_sales: Okay — customer prefers no Dedicated for now. They asked if handing over the zip with artifacts requires an NDA.

sam_security: We usually deliver SOC2/ISO publicly available artifacts without extra NDA. Pen-test details (vulnerability specifics) are considered sensitive — prefer redacted findings or deliver under NDA. We can produce a redacted pen-test summary for public delivery and full report on NDA.

legal_bot: Pen-test letter template: https://internal.redwood/legal/pen-test-template.pdf — use case: attach vendor signature page + company attestation.

maria_sales: Can you confirm the exact files that will be in the zip? I'll tell the customer.

sam_security: Planned zip contents: `SOC2_TypeII_report.pdf`, `ISO27001_certificate.pdf`, `PenTest_Summary_redacted.pdf`, `PenTest_Letter_draft_signed_by_redwood.pdf` (vendor signature pending), `staging_readme.txt` with token request instructions, `network_diagram.png`. I can add a small manifest file with dates.

josh_se: staging_readme should include the example curl to request ephemeral key and the sample allowlist CIDR. e.g.:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/staging-keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"scope":"nimbus-poc","ttl":86400}'
```

alex_engineering: If they later request a VPC we should flag that in the quote — infra provisioning time + IP egress limits.

maria_sales: Great — thanks. Plan: Sam to assemble zip and post link, Josh to add staging readme, Legal to chase vendor signature. I'll tell customer EOD Thu tentative and that full pen-test vendor sig may follow.

sam_security: I'll upload to secure S3 and share presigned link. Expect first draft by 1718960000 (tomorrow morning).

deploy-bot: Artifact bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-secure/evidence/nimbus-poc/1718890123_evidence_bundle_v1.zip (pre-signed link expires in 72h).

maria_sales: Perfect — forwarding to Nimbus now. :thumbsup:
